subject: Insurance
title: The Exxon Valdez Oil Spill
description: Learn The Exxon Valdez Oil Spill in one minute.

hook.text: In 1989, the Exxon Valdez spilled 11 million gallons of oil into Alaska's Prince William Sound.

buildup.text: The captain was allegedly intoxicated. The ship struck a reef. Oil coated 1,300 miles of pristine Alaskan coastline.

discovery.text: Exxon's insurance covered only a fraction. The company paid most costs itself.

twist.text: Environmental liability insurance barely existed before the spill.

climax.text: The Exxon Valdez created an entire insurance category.

quiz.question: What insurance product grew from the Exxon Valdez spill?
